lines: Not that own body: own-nature is said
separately; but what? In knower-power and knower,
the rest-receptacle, the form — that self-luminous
l4.sanskrit_cite: na tat svaṃ vapuḥ svarūpasya pṛthaguktatvāt kiṃ tarhi tat pramātṛśaktau pramātari ca yat viśrāntibhājanaṃ yat rūpaṃ tat khalu tat tat svaprakāśam eva tat prakāśate na tu kiṃcid api prati iti sarvajñatvam anavasthāviruddhadharmayogaś ca iti dūrāpāstam

reads_against.argmap: How is the objection answered? → Answer: 'own body' was mislocated — vedyatā = viśrānti-bhājana in pramātṛ-śakti, self-luminous toward no object: sarvajñatā without regress.
